levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن یحیی بن عمران الأشعری

notes: «یَرْفَعُهُ إِلَی أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» names the Imam right after the attribution marker: he is the last link (owner ruling 2)
«ع» is a blessing and is left out; «لِبَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ» is the addressee of the saying, not a link
Persian letter forms (ی, ک) are copied as they stand in the text
